Subject: Thanks for the call — next steps and rotating demo slots

Hi Sanjay,

Thanks again for taking time today to walk through Acme Health's use case. Quick recap: you're focused on lowering per-inference cost for secure on-prem workloads, need predictable latency for triage workflows, and want to validate model parity before committing to Dedicated capacity.

Next steps I suggested on the call:
- Run a 45–60min technical demo + deep dive with our infra engineer (proposed: Aditya)
- Share a short questionnaire on access & security details before the demo
- Draft an initial mutual action plan (timeline + decision makers)

To make scheduling simple across your US, EU and APAC stakeholders, we usually propose a rotating weekly slot so the burden of odd-hours is shared across teams. Below are three rotating options — pick one or tell me constraints and I'll send a recurring invite:

Option A (rotate weekly)
- Week 1: US-friendly morning (US Pacific 8:00 / US Eastern 11:00) — works well for internal Product owners
- Week 2: EU-friendly late afternoon (UK 16:00 / CET 17:00) — best for engineering in London/Frankfurt
- Week 3: APAC-friendly evening (India 19:30 / Singapore 22:00) — covers Bangalore/Singapore teams

Option B (two alternating slots)
- Slot 1: US morning (PDT 9:00 / EDT 12:00)
- Slot 2: EU morning / APAC evening (CEST 10:00 / IST 13:30 / SGT 17:00)

If any of these look good I can propose exact dates. I've attached a short deck with demo options and a proposed technical agenda.

Available times: I put a few tentative picks on my Calendly here: https://calendly.com/redwood-demo/60min

Would love to lock a 60-minute deep dive this week or next. Marking Aditya on copy to coordinate the technical scope.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
